  plan digest over every per-definition plan; all fleet writes require
  explicit whole-selection authorisation and infer no composition or
  inheritance from directory nesting.

constraints.statement: install admits one explicitly named immutable RC without changing definitions. sync installs/verifies only the selected exact basis and never consults selector. adopt --dry-run resolves annotated selector/immutable RC and presents cut/tag/commit/tree/manifest/current-definition-byte/plan digests without mutation. Mutating adopt requires exact prior plan acceptance, re-derives before installation, installs only bound target, rechecks definition bytes and atomically changes only basis and basis-relative schema; drift refuses. status/verify/list/manifest/resolve are definition-read-only. Fleet adoption requires accepted aggregate digest over every per-definition plan and whole-selection authorization for all writes; nesting implies neither composition nor inheritance. Missing cuts, moved immutable tags, tag/commit or manifest mismatches, missing/extra/changed members, ambiguous discovery, unaccepted/stale plans, URI escape, redirected store, undeclared entry types or malformed markers fail closed.

grounding.quote:
Exactly one correctly ordered marker span may be replaced;
the bytes before and after it, trailing whitespace included, stay
project-owned and byte-identical, and appending a new span preserves all
existing bytes as an exact prefix. The bootstrap routes agents to the
applicable Product Definition, the exact installed basis and the owning
sources; it can neither restate nor override them (P6, P3, P5).

constraints.statement: agent_bootstrap embeds no other constitution; it names one basis-qualified entrypoint and marker-managed discovery blocks in local instruction files. Targets are portable relative paths resolved against product.source_project; absolute paths, parent traversal, redirection and escape fail closed. Fleet source projects stay within the explicitly authorized fleet root and every target is preflighted before first write. Replace exactly one correctly ordered marker span, preserving all outside bytes including trailing whitespace; append preserves old bytes as exact prefix. Bootstrap only routes to definition/exact basis/owners. Recursive discovery prunes exact names .git, .hg, .svn, .bzr, .venv, venv, node_modules, vendor, site-packages, build, dist, out, target, .gradle, .tox, .nox, .cache, .ruff_cache, .mypy_cache, .pytest_cache, __pycache__, .genesis and .stdo. A discovered definition cannot itself be a symlink. Pruning is not proof that excluded trees lack independently governed Products.

exceptions: Newly staged immutable installs may remain unused after refusal/failure.

grounding.quote:
Only the selected basis and schema, the existing
composition locators and contracts, and the selected native and install
links may change; historical installs and unrelated consumer content stay
available and unchanged. It creates no consumer-local checker and changes
no Product meaning or local semantic map (P3, P6, P2).

constraints.statement: cohort-update first presents the complete plan without consumer effects; exact accepted plan is re-derived before mutation. Verify selected cohort dependency closure and each companion definition/release record/admitted members before reliance. Stage absent immutable installs, verify existing ones without in-place repair and preflight every consumer target. Changes are restricted to selected basis/schema, existing composition locators/contracts and selected native/install links; historical installs and unrelated content remain unchanged/available. No consumer-local checker, Product meaning change or local semantic-map change is created. adopt/sync/fleet keep their narrower contracts. Caller explicitly selects every native route and derived context; empty selection means selected none, not semantic absence.

grounding.quote:
The operation requires an exclusive consumer
write scope during application. It claims no crash-atomic transaction
across independent filesystem paths: abrupt process or host loss, or
unavailable rollback storage, requires recovery from the presented
preimages before the complete relation can be claimed (P5, P4b).

constraints.statement: For every selected derived context, missing/ambiguous/changed/unavailable program, map or source evidence holds the whole update before consumer effects. Only the source owner performs semantic re-entry; the manager cannot relabel old maps current. Source freshness proves integrity, not semantic conformance/verdict. After staging, recheck consumer preimages and source evidence; report completion only after verifying every selected resulting binding/companion. Pre-effect refusal retains prior state; caught application failure restores affected preimages and reports no completion. Application requires exclusive consumer write scope. No cross-path crash atomicity is claimed; process/host loss or unavailable rollback requires preimage recovery before claiming the complete relation.

conditions: For operations with an intended external write effect, including install, sync, mutating adopt, fleet adoption and complete update.

grounding.quote:
Abrupt process or
  host loss, where no caught failure establishes that the update fell
  short, is `completion_unknown` (`indeterminate`), never `completed` or
  `not_effected`. `completion_unknown`, and `not_effected` with its end
  not established, are effects of uncertain completion under
  [ACTIVATION §3 Effects](ACTIVATION.md#effects): recovery from the
  presented preimages reconciles them, as
  [ACTIVATION §5](ACTIVATION.md#5-work-state-and-restart) states, before
  any repetition or claim of the complete relation.

constraints.statement: For 'intended effect occurred', completed→satisfied requires evidence of the entire effect. Refusal before any effect with retained prior-state evidence is not_effected→falsified and ended. Caught application failure is also not_effected→falsified: the complete update fell short and no later part is applied, regardless of rollback verification. Verified restoration establishes the effect's end; unverified restoration or unavailable rollback leaves the end unestablished, recorded as a residual naming needed verification without changing falsified. Name unused newly staged installs as the part that did occur. Abrupt process/host loss without a caught failure establishing shortfall yields completion_unknown→indeterminate, never completed or not_effected. Reconcile unknown completion or unestablished end from presented preimages before repetition or complete-relation claims.

grounding.quote:
- Command without an intended effect. A command without an intended
  external effect, such as `verify` or `adopt --dry-run`, has no value
  under Effects, and its refusal maps by cause as above. A condition it
  reports about the subject it evaluates, such as a member that `verify`
  finds missing, extra or changed, is a counterexample to that command's
  own predicate, `falsified`, not a refusal.

constraints.statement: Refusal also answers whether the operation may apply its effect on its exact subject/basis. Before commencement this is admission/activation; afterward it is construction availability. Missing exact-plan acceptance or fleet whole-selection authorization is missing operation authority: admission_refused(authority)→out_of_frame, naming required acceptance/authorization and owner. Every other refusal listed by the source has a basis cause, including byte/preimage drift, stale plan, ambiguous discovery/no exact subject, integrity failures, path/locator/marker boundary failure and deficient derived evidence: admission_refused(basis) before beginning or re_entry_requested(basis) after, both invalid_basis, naming failed coordinates and applicable source owner. Commands without intended external effect have no Effects result; refusals still map by cause. A verify finding of a missing/extra/changed member is falsified for its own predicate, not a refusal. Refused/failed/unknown operations must not be combined as completed; known caught failure with unverified restoration must not be called undecided; missing acceptance must not be called defective basis.
